records.fact: Narayan et al. reported SIRT2 as required for TNF-alpha-mediated necroptosis.
The contemporaneous Nature News & Views item summarized the Narayan SIRT2-necroptosis result.
Cai et al. directly cited Narayan in a necroptosis paper before the retraction.
Webster et al. directly cited Narayan in a pre-retraction review.
Vitner et al. directly cited Narayan in experimental-method context; the Gaucher-disease conclusion had its own experimental basis.
